label: L-01
title: _sellYield acts on the raw token balance, so 1-wei donations (or a strategy's own sub-dust delivery) brick every harvest
description: Coverage/sell logic keyed on IERC20.balanceOf(this) instead of the delta SYA delivered this call, and does not mirror SYA's paused-token skip; any non-zero balance triggers a revert-in-loop (RouteNotConfigured) or a Router NG dust exchange that reverts. Root is story-002 Flow step 5's prescribed rule.
impact: None. Harvest reverts atomically; the unharvested yield stays in the strategies and SYA pays it out on a later claim.
attackPath: Natural (no adversary, fails in the HONEST invariant config): a non-exempt strategy delivers a sub-router-threshold amount (e.g. 298075 wei USDe); Router NG reverts 'Received nothing' and the whole harvest reverts.
Griefer: any EOA donates 1 wei of a strategy token whose strategy delivers 0 this round (routed -> router dust revert; unrouted -> RouteNotConfigured).
Caller workaround in the same block: add that strategy to exemptStrategies (exempt tokens are skipped by _sellYield).
likelihood: high - occurs naturally with no attacker
externalRequirements: A strategy that delivers dust/zero in the round being harvested.
severityRationale: The honest-config failure raises likelihood (this will happen in normal operation, not only under griefing), which rules out QA/Info and puts it at the top of Low. It does not raise impact: no value is at risk, the revert is atomic, and the caller has a per-call parameter workaround (exempt the strategy), so this is availability friction on a stateless helper rather than impaired protocol function. SYA's own claim path is unaffected. The workaround is degraded by L-04 (the operator script cannot name the offending token), which is recorded there rather than inflating this finding. Faithful to story-002 Flow step 5, whose balance-based rule is the root (F-03).
recommendation: Snapshot strategy-token balances before sya.claim and sell only the delta (or skip balances below a dust threshold / skip tokens SYA reports paused); add an owner sweep for strays. Amend story-002 Flow step 5 (F-03).

evidence.fork: test_audit_dust_routed_baseline_succeeds (DOLA skim mocked to deliver 0): ethOut 2512669567563236; test_audit_dust_routed_oneWeiDonation_bricks: ok=false, revert data 0x; test_audit_dust_unrouted_oneWeiDonation_bricks: no-dust ethOut 2512669567563236, after donation 0x92e88db9...865377367054516e17014ccded1e7d814edc9ce4 (RouteNotConfigured(DOLA)); test_audit_router_oneWei_reverts: thresholds above.
evidence.invariants: invariant_liveness_dust FAIL (adversarial, forge+medusa: 14150 wei DOLA donation + DOLA delivers 0 -> 'Received nothing'). invariant_liveness_naturalDust FAILS IN THE HONEST CONFIG too (forge+medusa: USDe delivers 298075 wei -> router 'Received nothing'), i.e. the DoS needs no adversary - an honest system state with a small strategy surplus reaches it. Unrouted variant proven by test_tripwire_unroutedDust_tripsLiveness.

instances.note: router.exchange inside loop reverts on dust < 1e13 wei (SLITHER-040)

faithfulness.specText: story-002 Flow step 5: "Skip if `IERC20(token).balanceOf(this) == 0`. Otherwise, if `!routes[token].configured`, revert `RouteNotConfigured(token)`."  versus  src/CLAUDE.md: "Public, stateless between calls ... The contract holds no balances between calls."
faithfulness.specSource: story-002 doc Technical Details > Flow; src/CLAUDE.md Design decisions
faithfulness.deviation: Faithful to story-002. The story's balance-based rule assumes the 'holds no balances' invariant, which any outsider can break by donating tokens, so the story's own mechanism enables the DoS.

related: DEDUP-011 (F-05/CODE-008(c): revert not decodable by operator)
